summary.text: The Brothers' War was the decades-long war between Urza and Mishra over the two halves of a Thran stone, fought with ancient machines across Terisiare and ended by the Sylex Blast.

bio.text: The brothers' feud grew from double-crossings and sneak attacks into open war, and at a second summit Mishra persuaded Kayla to steal Urza's Mightstone, after which Urza reclaimed it and declared war.
Peace talks at Kroog ended disastrously and marked the official start of the war, and the Phyrexian demon entered Dominaria as Gix.
The war spread across Yotia and the Great Desert, Kroog fell, and Mishra was corrupted by Phyrexian influence.
It killed millions and stripped Terisiare of resources, and Urza and Mishra reworked salvaged Thran thopters to carry troops.
Urza ended it by activating the Golgothian Sylex on Argoth, an event that sent Dominaria into an Ice Age and lofted debris that created the Dark.
In the aftermath Argive, Yotia, Yumok, Malpiri and Korlis collapsed and the Dark Age began.

status.text: The war is long over; later card text still calls it the war that left Adarkar barren, and in the Time Spiral story the Sylex Blast is said to have created the first known rift.
